rule.name: SpringQueryConcatenation
rule.message: Write the query as constant text (a text block) and pass values as bind parameters; for a list of values use NamedParameterJdbcTemplate or JdbcClient with in (:ids). Joining or formatting values into SQL or JPQL allows injection.
